build_VSGN_model: build a VSGN model instance with an opt config dict containing bb_hidden_dim, batch_size, is_train, and input_feat_dim keys
run_VSGN_forward_train: run the VSGN forward pass in training mode to compute losses, actionness, startness, and endness scores from input features
run_VSGN_forward_inference: run the VSGN forward pass in inference mode to return predicted locations, scores, adjusted boundaries, and supplementary scores
review_VSGN_forward_test: review the VSGN _forward_test method that generates encoder and decoder predictions from classification and regression outputs using anchors
review_VSGN_supplementary_heads: review the VSGN head_actionness, head_startness, and head_endness Conv1d heads that generate supplementary temporal action scores
